steps.text:
<Canvas>
<Mark target="notebook" shape="underline" u={0.5} v={0.42} w={0.8}/>
<Panel id="steps" near="notebook" side="right" w={580}>
<Heading>Fence against a wall</Heading>
<Text tone="muted">One side is the wall, so 100 m covers one width and two lengths.</Text>
<Equations>2x + y &= 100 \\ A &= x y = x(100 - 2x) \\ A &= 100x - 2x^2 \\ A' &= 100 - 4x = 0 \\ x &= 25</Equations>
<Steps>
<Step><Text>Width x, length y along the wall.</Text></Step>
<Step highlight><Text>50 m parallel to the wall, 25 m out.</Text></Step>
</Steps>
</Panel>
<Panel x={980} y={180} w={580}>
<Plot fn="x*(100 - 2*x)" xmin={0} xmax={50} ymin={0} ymax={1400} points="25,1250" label="area peaks at x = 25"/>
<Note kind="check">Max area 1250 m².</Note>
</Panel>
<Arrow from="#steps" to="notebook@0.5,0.5"/>
</Canvas>
